messages.text: Somerset's title hopes hit while Stokes stars with ball for Durham

metadata.summary: Dom Bess dented the Rothesay County Championship title hopes of old club Somerset after he struck 77 for Yorkshire to set a tricky final-day victory target of 287.
metadata.content: County Championship: Somerset's title hopes hit as former England captain Ben Stokes stars with ball for Durham | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content County Championship: Somerset's title hopes hit as former England captain Ben Stokes stars with ball for Durham Ben Stokes claimed a first five-wicket haul at Chester-le-Street since 2014 but champions Durham endured a tough day three in the County Championship; Somerset's title hopes took a big hit as they are on 73-3 chasing 287 heading into day four Thursday 17 September 2026 19:56, UK Image: Dom Bess has put Yorkshire in a good position against Somerset (SWpix) Dom Bess dented the Rothesay County Championship title hopes of old club Somerset after he struck 77 for Yorkshire to set a tricky final-day victory target of 287. Spinner Bess walked to the crease with Yorkshire on 54-6 and after he joined forces with George Hill to take the hosts up to 128 at the end of day two, the duo kicked on during the morning session and put on 166 for the seventh wicket. Hill narrowly missed out on a century with 89 before Bess was out for 77, which helped Yorkshire up to 275 before Somerset were reduced to 73-3 during a rain-affected chase, with a further 214 runs required to reclaim top spot.
